input.command: python -c 'import os, duckdb, matplotlib.pyplot as plt; import pandas as pd; os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True); db=duckdb.connect(); data=db.execute("SELECT year(crash_date) AS year, sum(coalesce(number_of_motorist_killed, 0)) AS motorist_deaths, sum(coalesce(number_of_cyclist_killed, 0)) AS cyclist_deaths FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE year(crash_date) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", ["data/crashes.parquet"]).fetchdf(); data[["motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]]=data[["motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].astype(int); data["year"]=data["year"].astype(int); years=data["year"]; plt.figure(figsize=(10,5.8)); plt.plot(years, data["motorist_deaths"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2, label="Motorist deaths"); plt.plot(years, data["cyclist_deaths"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2, label="Cyclist deaths"); plt.xticks(years, rotation=45); plt.ylabel("Deaths"); plt.xlabel("Crash year"); plt.title("Motorist and cyclist deaths by year, NYC (2013–2025)"); plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25); plt.legend(frameon=False); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("out/option_1.png", dpi=160); plt.close(); data.to_csv("out/values_1.csv", index=False); x=range(len(data)); width=0.38; plt.figure(figsize=(10,5.8)); plt.bar([i-width/2 for i in x], data["motorist_deaths"], width, label="Motorist deaths", color="#3569a8"); plt.bar([i+width/2 for i in x], data["cyclist_deaths"], width, label="Cyclist deaths", color="#e28e2c"); plt.xticks(list(x), years, rotation=45); plt.ylabel("Deaths"); plt.xlabel("Crash year"); plt.title("Annual motorist and cyclist deaths, NYC (2013–2025)"); plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25); plt.legend(frameon=False); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("out/option_2.png", dpi=160); plt.close(); data["motorist_to_cyclist_ratio"]=data["motorist_deaths"]/data["cyclist_deaths"]; data.to_csv("out/values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f"); plt.figure(figsize=(10,5.8)); plt.plot(years, data["motorist_to_cyclist_ratio"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2, color="#6c4c9a"); plt.xticks(years, rotation=45); plt.ylabel("Motorist deaths per cyclist death"); plt.xlabel("Crash year"); plt.title("Motorist-to-cyclist death ratio by year, NYC (2013–2025)"); plt.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("out/option_3.png", dpi=160); plt.close(); data[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].to_csv("out/values_2.csv", index=False); print(data.to_string(index=False))'

ANSWER:
Motorist deaths exceeded cyclist deaths every year, peaking at 139 in 2020, while cyclist deaths peaked at 31 in both 2019 and 2023.
Motorist deaths were higher in every year, with 110 motorist deaths versus 11 cyclist deaths in 2013 and 81 versus 23 in 2025.
Motorist deaths were 2.65 to 10.00 times cyclist deaths per year; the ratio was highest in 2013 and lowest in 2019.
